core_obligations: Group the conditions: the conditions on chains of primes agree with each other, the two conditions on opens agree because quasi-compact opens are finite unions of standard opens, and the implication from the prime condition to the open condition uses the cited lemma (proof lines 4993-4999).
Close the remaining implications to the topological conditions and give the second proof reducing the topological part to a statement of the Topology chapter (proof lines 4999-5018).
proof_roadmap: Chain the equivalent formulations through the open conditions (proof lines 4992-4999).
Finish the topological equivalences and give the second proof (proof lines 4999-5019).
difficulty_reason: The lemma collects nine equivalent conditions on the spectrum of a ring, mixing topological ones (profinite, Hausdorff, totally disconnected) with order-theoretic ones on the primes (statement lines 4975-4990). The proof groups the conditions by translating between quasi-compact opens and standard opens, uses the cited lemma for the implication from minimality of primes to closedness of standard opens, and then closes the chain to the topological conditions, with a second proof reducing the topological part to a result of the Topology chapter (proof lines 4992-5019). Keeping track of which translation connects which pair of conditions is the content. H2.
